hero.intro: I’m a Full-Stack Web Developer with a passion for turning ideas into functional, meaningful digital experiences.
hero.mission: I don't just want to write code. I want to build things that matter.

items.title: Code
items.body: Passion for building clean, efficient code.

heading: Curious by default.
Precise by practice.
about.portraitAlt: Stylized digital portrait of a full-stack developer working at a desk with a laptop and dual monitors, rendered in indigo and violet tones
paragraphs: My background reaches beyond technology into healthcare, public administration, and customer service. That mix shapes how I build: I don't only ask whether something works, but who's using it, what problem it solves, and how the experience could be better.
My goal is to keep sharpening my technical skills while combining them with the professional experience and education I've built in those fields.
I'm particularly interested in the intersection of technology and healthcare, where better digital solutions can improve workflows, access to information, and people's overall experiences.

Long term, I want to build technology that connects people across healthcare, business, and everyday life, and to use what I'm learning to create opportunities, develop innovative solutions, build businesses, and eventually lead projects and teams of my own.

items.title: Testing & quality

items.title: Responsive design
items.body: Translating designs into fluid layouts that hold up from small phones to wide desktops.

items.name: Rocket Elevators
items.imageAlt: Screenshot of the Rocket Elevators management dashboard
items.description: A full-stack management platform for a fictional elevator company: a public marketing site, a customer quote-request flow, and an internal dashboard for tracking buildings, elevators, and service requests. Built to practise designing one product end to end across the UI, a REST API, and a relational database.

items.name: Rocket Elevators Admin App
items.imageAlt: Screenshot of the Rocket Elevators admin app screens
items.description: Full-stack administrative platform for managing Rocket Elevators users, agents, transactions, records, and content.

items.name: CodeBloggs
items.imageAlt: Screenshot of the CodeBloggs feed and profile pages
items.description: A social blogging web app where people sign up, manage a profile, publish posts, and interact through a shared feed. Built to practise authentication, full CRUD, and document data modelling on the MERN stack.

items.name: Rocket Food Delivery
items.imageAlt: Mobile food-delivery platform connecting customers, restaurants, and couriers through restaurant browsing, ordering, order history, and delivery management.
items.description: A full-stack management platform for a fictional food delivery company: a public marketing site, a customer quote-request flow, and an internal dashboard for tracking restaurants, orders, and deliveries. Built to practise designing one product end to end across the UI, a REST API, and a relational database.
